source: llama-server --help (hand-seeded from the documented flags, not captured from this build)
notes: llama.cpp versions are build numbers, so this file describes the flags around build b7000 rather than one exact commit. Defaults in llama.cpp move between builds more often than in a semver project: if a default here disagrees with your build's --help, your build wins, and the flag simply stays in the fingerprint.

params.name: model
params.help: GGUF file to load. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: ctx-size
params.help: Context size in tokens. 0 means take it from the GGUF metadata.

params.name: n-gpu-layers
params.help: Layers offloaded to the GPU. Use a large number (999) for all. Builds with a GPU backend compiled in may offload everything by default — verify against your build and record what you passed.

params.name: threads
params.help: CPU threads for generation. -1 means one per physical core.

params.name: threads-batch
params.help: CPU threads for prompt processing.

params.name: batch-size
params.help: Logical maximum batch size.

params.name: ubatch-size
params.help: Physical micro-batch size — the one that actually changes prefill speed.

params.name: parallel
params.help: Parallel request slots. Context is split between them.

params.name: cont-batching
params.help: Continuous batching. On by default in llama-server.

params.name: no-cont-batching
params.help: Disable continuous batching.

params.name: flash-attn
params.help: Flash attention. auto enables it where the backend supports it.

params.name: cache-type-k
params.help: KV cache key type. q8_0 and q4_0 trade accuracy for cache size.

params.name: cache-type-v
params.help: KV cache value type. Needs flash attention for the quantized types.

params.name: kv-unified
params.help: Single unified KV buffer shared by all slots.

params.name: swa-full
params.help: Keep the full KV cache for sliding-window models.

params.name: defrag-thold
params.help: KV cache defragmentation threshold.

params.name: no-mmap
params.help: Read the whole model instead of memory-mapping it. Slower to start, avoids page-cache thrash.

params.name: mlock
params.help: Lock the model in RAM.

params.name: split-mode
params.help: How to split across multiple GPUs.

params.name: tensor-split
params.help: Per-GPU split proportions.

params.name: main-gpu
params.help: GPU used for small tensors and, with split-mode none, everything.

params.name: device
params.help: Explicit backend device list.

params.name: rope-scaling
params.help: RoPE scaling method.

params.name: rope-freq-base
params.help: RoPE base frequency. 0 keeps the model's own.

params.name: rope-freq-scale
params.help: RoPE frequency scaling factor.

params.name: yarn-orig-ctx
params.help: Original context size for YaRN scaling.

params.name: n-predict
params.help: Server-side cap on generated tokens.

params.name: keep
params.help: Tokens of the prompt kept when the context is shifted.

params.name: temp
params.help: Sampling temperature.

params.name: top-k
params.help: Top-k sampling.

params.name: top-p
params.help: Top-p sampling.

params.name: min-p
params.help: Min-p sampling.

params.name: repeat-penalty
params.help: Repetition penalty. 1.0 disables it.

params.name: seed
params.help: Random seed. -1 is random.

params.name: jinja
params.help: Use the GGUF's Jinja chat template. Required for tool calls on most recent models.

params.name: chat-template
params.help: Override the chat template by name.

params.name: reasoning-format
params.help: How reasoning content is returned.

params.name: draft-max
params.help: Maximum draft tokens per speculative step.

params.name: draft-min
params.help: Minimum draft tokens per speculative step.

params.name: model-draft
params.help: Draft model for speculative decoding.

params.name: gpu-layers-draft
params.help: Draft-model layers offloaded to the GPU.

params.name: numa
params.help: NUMA optimisation strategy.

params.name: host
params.help: Bind address. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: port
params.help: Bind port. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: api-key
params.help: Required API key. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: alias
params.help: Model name reported by the API. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: threads-http
params.help: HTTP worker threads. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: metrics
params.help: Expose the Prometheus endpoint. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: slots
params.help: Expose the slots endpoint. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: no-webui
params.help: Disable the built-in web UI. Dropped from the fingerprint.
